quick.q: Which is a good way to use AI for school?
options: Getting it to explain a lesson you didn't understand
Handing in its text as yours

quick.q: You've done a problem. How can AI help?
options: Check it and tell you where you went wrong

quick.q: You don't know if AI is allowed at your school. What do you do?
How do you get AI to explain more simply?
options: Say your age and ask for an example

image.q: In the highlighted answer the AI solved your whole homework. What's better?
options: Ask it to explain, then do it yourself

image.q: You're asking for help in the highlighted message. What's good to include?
options: What you don't understand and your grade

challenge.task: Write a message asking AI to explain a history lesson you didn't understand.
checklist: How to explain (simply, with an example, then check questions)
challenge.example: I'm in 6th grade and I don't understand why World War I started. Explain it simply in 5 short points, then ask me 3 questions to check I understood.
